annotations.title: Recommend a travel eSIM for a trip

description: Recommend which travel eSIM to buy for a trip. Give the destination (country, region or city), any other countries on the same trip, the trip length and how the traveller uses data (light: maps and messages; normal: plus social media and browsing; heavy: video, video calls or hotspot). Estimates the data needed and returns up to 3 plans valid for the whole trip, each with a reason: best_fit (cheapest that covers the estimate), budget (cheaper, below the estimate) and roomier (more data). Each plan has its price in USD, data, daily cap, hotspot rule, networks and page link.

also_countries.description: Other countries on the same trip, by name or ISO code; only plans covering all of them are recommended.

destination.description: Where the traveller is going: a country, region or city, by name or ISO code (Mexico, JP, Europe, Rome).

locale.description: Language for plan names, destination names and page links: en, es, de, fr, pt or he. Default en.

trip_days.description: Trip length in days (the whole trip for several countries).

usage.description: How the traveller uses data: light (maps, messages), normal (plus social media, browsing; default) or heavy (video, video calls, hotspot).
